title: CAM Advanced Parameter Catalog — 5-Axis, Turning, Mill-Turn ~1,500 Schemas
description: Generate parameter schemas for advanced CAM cycle parameters: 5-axis cycles (25+ types including swarf, blade, impeller, tube, dental, cavity — ~475 params with tool axis control, collision avoidance, blade/impeller geometry, surface quality fields), turning cycles (18+ types — ~342 params with insert geometry, CSS mode, grooving, threading), and probing/grinding/misc cycles (~180 params). These are the most physics-intensive parameters, with direct coupling to SLD, deflection, and thermal models.

reference: hyperMILL training manuals (5-axis blade, impeller, turning, mill-turn sections)

forge_triple.hook: fiveAxisTiltLimitValidator — BUILT — blocks tilt angle exceeding machine limits
forge_triple.action: generate_cam_advanced_catalog — BUILT — generates advanced CAM artifacts from schemas
